programmes.d: The Teletubbies and a group of children see Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty snake.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
A little boy’s daddy is a policeman, he shows us his uniform and badges. The Teletubbies are sitting at their table when they hear a funny noise.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
A voice trumpet brings a message, which makes Po laugh. The Teletubbies watch Mark and Zoe decorate cake with butter icing, chocolate and strawberries.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...
The Teletubbies pop up to say hello. They watch a boy and his grandad building a barbecue. A voice trumpet brings a message that makes the Teletubbies laugh and run away.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.

The Teletubbies watch a group of children play hide and seek. The Teletubbies play their own hiding game. Tinky Winky can’t see Dipsy when he hides, and Laa-Laa can’t see Tinky Winky and Dipsy when they hide.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.
The Teletubbies watch an traditional Christmas insert featuring children from a school in Scarborough. They are all busy making snowballs. All the snowballs are different sizes.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy help his mum paint some Rangoli patterns for the festival of Diwali. A decoration appears in Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies love jump, but they stop to see Andy Brown and some children take a trip on a boat to see Funghi the Dolphin. The Teletubbies are out in Teletubbyland. When they meet each other, they say hello, making sure no-one is missed out.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies have fun creeping round the column in Home Hill before watching some children doing gymnastics. Laa-Laa plays catch ball indoors with the other Teletubbies, but the Noo-Noo catches the ball first.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The toaster makes an extra piece of Tubby Toast – but who is going to eat it? The Teletubbies watch Emily And Jamie take their dog Jessie for a walk before giving her a bath.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast, so they go outside to play.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy show his friend his scrapbook. Tinky Winky puts Dipsy’s hat inside his bag. Then the Noo Noo sucks Tinky Winky’s bag inside his tummy.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
A door appears in Teletubbyland. The Tubbies have great fun opening and closing, knocking on and going through the door.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.
Tinky Winky counts to five. The Teletubbies watch some children feeding lambs. Dipsy makes up a magic tune and wakes up the other Teletubbies.
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.
Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.
The Teletubbies have fun falling over. The Teletubbies watch some children go swimming with Stephanie.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.
The Teletubbies are having their Tubby Toast when a voice trumpet brings them a message. The Teletubbies watch Alex Pascall and some children go looking for birds in the park.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

Laa-Laa has fun watering the flowers when a watering can appears. The Teletubbies watch some children making flowers. The Teletubbies make up a dance. The animals are on the march through Teletubbyland.
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies run out of the house to find their favourite things. Then they run off to watch some children flying kites. A special cloud falls on Tinky Winky's head.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies watch some children running. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy runs and runs. He runs past Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa, Po and the Noo Noo.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.
It's time for Dipsy to have some Tubby Toast. The Teletubbies watch some children have fun in their paddling pool on a sunny day.
The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.
Dipsy is out for a walk in his hat. He joins the other Tubbies to watch two girls have their hands painted by their auntie. Po puts her hand in her Tubby Custard.
In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet.
The Tubbies watch a little boy talk about his cat. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa‑Laa say "Eh-oh" to Po through the window.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits.

The Teletubbies watch Simone and Cacha help make colourful costumes and then dance in a Carnival. Laa-Laa loves to play with her ball, it bounces everywhere. A magic house appears before it's time for Tubby Bye-Bye.
Dancing; children paint pictures and patterns on eggs; magical tree appears.
Some children go to the woods to see some bluebells. Po is walking in Teletubbyland when a bluebell appears. Po shows Laa-Laa the bluebell and then one by one more and more bluebells appear.
A voice trumpet rises and play some music and the Teletubbies dance. A little girl shows us her piano and the sound the keys make. Another voice trumpet makes a big roaring noise.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.
Dipsy and Laa-Laa discover a funny noise. They join the others to watch some children pretend to be animals. The animals march through Teletubbyland, and the Teletubbies dance around Teletubbyland.
Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.
A voice trumpet rises and sings Po a Nursery Rhyme. The Teletubbies watch some children making lots of different things using gold & silver.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
The Teletubbies watch children making a boat they then put it in a paddling pool to see if it will float. Tinky Winky’s bag falls in a puddle.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.
Tinky Winky sings a song about his bag and it appears. Dipsy sings a song about his hat and it appears. Laa-Laa sings a song about her ball and it appears.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.

The Teletubbies watch some children practise yoga. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies are very busy. Tinky Winky is marching with his bag, Dipsy is dancing with his hat, Laa-Laa is playing with her ball and Po is riding her scooter.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.

The Teletubbies watch some girls spend the day picking and sorting vegetables in their nannies garden. Tinky Winky sets the table for Tubby Toast, but when he calls the other Tubbies, Noo-Noo tidies it all up.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
Tinky Winky & Po burst out of the house to say Eh-oh and enjoy a big hug. Then they do it again. They join Dipsy & Laa-Laa to watch a little girl read the story of Jack & The Beanstalk.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies sit down for Tubby Toast. After they’ve eaten some more toast lands on their plates. They eat that, and some more toast lands again.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.
A black and a white cloud appear in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the colour black.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.
A little girl goes to the shops to buy a Sari. The Noo Noo is tidying up the Teletubbies blankets, but Po doesn’t want the Noo Noo to tidy up her blanket.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.
Po invites Tinky Winky to dance, and they dance all around Home Hill. Tamzin Griffin pretends to be Funny Lady and tells the story of the very proud crown.
The Teletubbies dance a walking dance. They stop to watch a group of children are riding on a rickshaw. In Teletubbyland, Po is riding her scooter.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.

All four Teletubbies go under the slide. The Teletubbies watch some children go over a stile, under some trees and through a gate. When Laa-Laa goes for walk, Tinky Winky and Dipsy secretly follow her.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.

Teletubbies love to dance, but they love children even more. So everything stops when the Teletubbies watch a film all about a little boy's special friend: a pig call Winnie. There's time for Tubby Custard before the Tubby Bye Bye.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.
The Teletubbies are having some Tubby Custard when they stop to watch some children who are going strawberry picking.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
Over the hills and far away, Po loves to ride her scooter fast and slow. The Teletubbies watch Emily ride in her trap, drawn by her pony Jester.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.

Laa-Laa walks up to say “Eh-oh”. Then she goes to find Po, Dipsy and Tinky Winky and brings them in to say “Eh-oh” too. The windmill turns and the Tubbies watch a group of children go paddling in the sea.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.
The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
It’s time for Tubby Toast. Po and Tinky Winky are so excited, they fall over. They join Dipsy and Laa-Laa to watch two children dig a big mud hole.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.

The Teletubbies walk in sideways, then run off to watch a little boy play cricket with his dad. In Teletubbyland,Tinky Winky runs away with Laa-Laa’s ball. Laa-Laa chases after him, through the house, over the hills and behind the trees.
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.
The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"
The Teletubbies are very happy and have fun jumping all over Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children jumping. Tinky Winky makes up a dance.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.

Dipsy is out for a walk when a strong wind blows his hat away. The hat disappears into Home Hill, but Dipsy doesn't know where it has gone. Noo Noo blows the hat back out of Home Hill to Dipsy, who is very happy.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.
